title: Open strict quotient comparison and actual completion-unit normalization
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$ and a uniformizer $t$, and put $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Assume $(R,(t))$ satisfies [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. On the small pro-etale site of each scheme $T$ put $B_T=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and use the ordinary unbounded derived category $D(B_T)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $H\in D(B_T)$ write $Q_T(H)_n=\operatorname{Res}_n(H\otimes^L_{B_T}(A_n)_T)$ for the strict quotient tower on a single flat-term K-flat representative, with transitions induced by $A_{n+1}\to A_n$ and augmentation $x\mapsto x\otimes1$ [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower, def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules, lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. Put $C_T(H)=R\lim Q_T(H)$, using total right derived inverse limit on strict towers, and let $\eta_{T,H}:H\to C_T(H)$ be the map induced by this augmentation [lem-cbc-exact-product-functor-strict-limit].
Let $e:V\hookrightarrow W$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion]. Identify the two finite coefficient systems and their limits by the constant-section and projection-normalized maps [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image]. Write $e^*$ for exact ringed-slice restriction [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]; under the identification of the slice site $W_{\mathrm{proet}}/V$ with $V_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization] it is the inverse image $e^{-1}$ [lem-sfb-proetale-object-inverse-image-restriction], so the preceding coefficient identifications apply to it. For every $H\in D(B_W)$ there is a natural isomorphism of derived strict $B_V$-towers
$$\tau_H:e^*Q_W(H)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_V(e^*H).$$
On flat-term K-flat representatives it is induced by the balanced tensor restriction maps sending $x\otimes a$ to the same restricted tensor. It commutes with every quotient transition and carries the pulled strict augmentation to the quotient augmentation of $e^*H$. It is independent of the representative through the canonical derived computation comparisons.
Let $\lambda_N:e^*R\lim N\xrightarrow{\sim}R\lim e^*N$ be the normalized exact-product comparison of [lem-cbc-exact-product-functor-strict-limit]. The natural derived isomorphisms
$$b_H=R\lim\tau_H:R\lim e^*Q_W(H)\xrightarrow{\sim}C_V(e^*H),\qquad
\rho_H=b_H\lambda_{Q_W(H)}:e^*C_W(H)\xrightarrow{\sim}C_V(e^*H)$$
satisfy $\rho_H e^*\eta_{W,H}=\eta_{V,e^*H}$. More precisely, if $\alpha_H:e^*H\to R\lim e^*Q_W(H)$ is the map of the pulled strict quotient augmentation, then
$$\alpha_H=\lambda_{Q_W(H)}e^*\eta_{W,H},\qquad b_H\alpha_H=\eta_{V,e^*H}.$$
Here $\lambda_N=\theta_{e^*N}^{-1}\kappa_N e^*(\theta_N)$ on the signed Roos models $\mathsf H_N^q=(\prod N_n)^q\oplus(\prod N_n)^{q-1}$, $d(x,y)=(dx,(1-s)x-dy)$: $\kappa_N$ is the canonical product comparison on both summands. Under the canonical exact-localization identification of derived open pullback, $\alpha_H$ is the augmented construction of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Thus $b_H$ identifies its ordinary-to-completed comparison with precisely the actual $\eta_{V,e^*H}$ whenever that completed functor is defined on complete inputs; the displayed augmented construction and equations hold for arbitrary $H$, without completeness, boundedness, constructibility or a quasi-compactness hypothesis on $e$.

proof.text: Construct the exact open operation presentation from normalizedOpenSections and openCoefficientOperationsExistence, then obtain its strict augmented tensor descent s. Obtain normalized signed Roos compatibility and its constant-tower unit equation for the same presentation and the graph-normalized ordinary pullback isomorphism. Apply Mathlib leftDerivedNatIso to the termwise ordinary comparison and the existing universal derivedCounit; exact restriction computes its own left derived functor. The leftDerivedNatTrans_app equation is exactly the required counit normalization of tower.

Define constantPull as the inverse constantRestriction followed by deltaW whiskered with the inverse tower comparison. Cancelling tower inverse with tower proves constantPull_normalized. Naturality of tower at augmentation_W then gives completedComparison after applying Rlim.

Expand alpha and the completion unit. The constant-tower unit equation supplied by normalized Roos restriction and naturality of lambda at augmentation_W give alpha_eq. This uses only functoriality and does not add a quotient-specific inverse-limit hypothesis.

Expand alpha and the target completion unit. Combine the two Rlim maps using functoriality, substitute the strict augmented square from s, and cancel constantRestriction inverse with constantRestriction. This proves b_alpha without a further Roos assertion.

Use alpha_eq supplied by the normalized Roos comparison, reassociate the composite and substitute b_alpha. This proves rho_unit. Assemble the three comparison records and these proved normalization identities, preserving every statement field.
